lines: Version thirty asked how one static whole holds observers and clocks. Version thirty-one splits prediction, recursion and geometry into separate theorems; version thirty-two attaches them to a native golden readout and predictive memory.
第三十版追问：一个静态整体如何容纳观察者与时钟。第三十一版把预测、递归与几何拆成各自独立的定理；第三十二版把它们接到一个原生黄金读口与预测记忆上。
Auric versions thirty-one and thirty-two: golden Cantor gates and predictive memory.
AURIC V31–V32：黄金康托门与预测记忆。
An unknown ruler, a fractal of gates, a one-sided readout, and exactly N plus two states.
一把未知的尺子，一族分形的门，一个单侧读口，以及恰好 N + 2 个状态。
Source contracts fix the second golden readout only up to c times the Born law plus noise, with mass c over x plus c, x being one over phi. Two exact basis readings force c to one; one is not enough.
源合同只把第二个黄金读口定到 c 乘 Born 律再加噪声，记录质量为 c/(x + c)，其中 x = 1/φ。两个精确的基读出迫使 c = 1；一个不够。

A native third reader with five fixed continuations gives c one, mass x, new mass x cubed. With residuals below epsilon and margin h, one minus c is at most four epsilon over h x squared; without a margin, nothing uniform.
一个原生第三读者配上五个固定后续，给出 c = 1、质量 x、新质量 x³。若残差小于 ε、裕量为 h，则 1 − c ≤ 4ε/(hx²)；没有裕量，就没有统一的结论。

Chaining a noisy readout forgets a factor c per round, yet repeated reads of a persistent orthogonal label identify it with error at most thirteen over n c squared. Under full control, nonzero contrast separates states, constant five twelfths at rank five.
把有噪读口串联起来，每轮遗忘 c 倍；但对持久的正交标签重复读取，仍能辨认它，误差至多 13/(nc²)。在全控制下，非零对比度能分离各态，秩五时常数为 5/12。

But state and ruler mix: control statistics see only c times rho minus the maximally mixed state, and averages. Making rho less pure while raising c changes nothing; this Fisher-null freedom is an interval of c.
但态与尺子会混在一起：控制统计只看得见 c(ρ − I/D) 和平均值。让 ρ 更混、同时提高 c，什么也不变；这份 Fisher 零方向的自由是 c 的一个区间。

Square-loss prediction from records is a projection, yet a qubit example has a negative coefficient, one minus root one plus s squared, over two. It is positive exactly when the state commutes with the records, then a completely positive conditional expectation.
从记录出发的平方损失预测是一个投影，但一个 qubit 例子的系数为负：(1 − √(1 + s²))/2。它为正，当且仅当态与各记录对易，此时是完全正的条件期望。

Allowing every future, the observer must keep exactly the state restricted to the recursive closure of future effects. It updates on its own; when futures span all thirteen-dimensional effects, a linear summary needs one hundred sixty-eight coordinates.
若允许一切未来，观察者必须保留的恰是态在未来效果递归闭包上的限制。它自行更新；当未来张成全部十三维效果时，线性摘要需要 168 个坐标。

Record information grows by orthogonal increments: each layer adds a score with zero conditional mean, so Fisher information adds its expected square, and a fixed coarse-graining loses exactly the expected conditional variance.
记录中的信息以正交增量增长：每一层都添上一个条件均值为零的得分，所以 Fisher 信息增加的是它的期望平方；固定粗化损失的恰是期望条件方差。
For a persistent binary target the gap is exactly a constant times the expected q times one minus q. Identifying records reach only the label's information; for a qubit angle, one.
对持久的二元目标，缺口恰为一个常数乘以 q(1 − q) 的期望。辨认出标签的记录只取得标签本身的信息；对一个 qubit 角度，这个预算是一。

Let golden layers fail to commute: layer k turns by plus or minus c k about a prefix-chosen axis, weights shrinking by phi to the minus two. Programs sharing n bits give gates between point two six six and two times phi to the minus two n apart.
让黄金各层不对易：第 k 层绕前缀选定的轴转 ±c_k，权重按 φ⁻² 递减。共享前 n 位的两个程序，给出的门相距在 φ⁻²ⁿ 的 0.266 倍与 2 倍之间。

So the gate image, projective image and Bell readout all have Hausdorff dimension log two over two log phi, about point seven two. First-bit separation matters: layers cancelling in pairs give only the identity.
所以门像、射影门像与 Bell 读出像的 Hausdorff 维数都是 log2/(2logφ)，约 0.72。首个不同位的分离必不可少：成对相消的层只给出恒等。

One Gram matrix carries metric and curvature: on the Bloch sphere, a quarter of d theta squared plus sine squared theta d phi squared, and half sine theta, with equality. A fixed readout gets Fisher information at most four g.
一个 Gram 矩阵同时承载度量与曲率：在 Bloch 球上分别为 (dθ² + sin²θ dφ²)/4 与 sinθ/2，约束取等号。固定读口的 Fisher 信息至多为 4g。

Two orthogonal directions cannot both be read in full: their informations sum to at most one. With a Bell reference, one four-outcome readout gets full information on three gate axes and, given the prefix, determines the golden gate.
两个正交方向不能同时被完全读出：信息之和至多为一。但借助 Bell 参考，一个四结果读口能在三条门轴上取得全部信息；给定前缀时，它确定黄金门。

Noncommuting layers make loops: the identity minus t s times the commutator, up to a cubic remainder; past the first layer, adjacent golden loops are strictly nontrivial. Records still grow: orthogonal clock labels stay root two apart.
不对易的层形成闭路：闭路等于恒等减去 ts 乘交换子，外加一个三阶余项；第一层之后，相邻黄金层的闭路严格非平凡。记录仍在增长：正交的时钟标签始终相距 √2。

In the native eighty-nine-dimensional carrier, program, data and reference fit while two to the N plus two is at most sixty-four: prefixes up to four bits are realised by native words, to any accuracy, with one common phase.
在原生八十九维载体中，只要 2^(N+2) ≤ 64，程序、数据与参考就放得下；至多四位的前缀能由原生门字以任意精度、一个共同相位实现。

Read the native matrix as a one-sided golden instrument: M zero is root x E, M one is x E plus zeta to the minus three P. It is complete, matches the native port up to zeta squared, and a zero erases the protected weight.
把原生矩阵读成单侧黄金仪器：M₀ = √x E，M₁ = xE + ζ⁻³P。它是完备的，与原生读口只差相位 ζ²；一旦读出零，受保护的权重就被抹去。
After n ones the mass is q zero plus one minus q zero times x to the two n, and the posterior climbs to one. The first zero, if it comes, waits on average exactly phi rounds.
连续 n 次读出一后，质量为 q₀ + (1 − q₀)x²ⁿ，后验升向一。第一次读出零——若它到来——平均恰好等待 φ 轮。

Conserving the pointer weight for every input means every Kraus operator commutes with P, so random mixing cannot hide leakage. Near conservation puts an exactly conserving isometry within square-root distance; a rotated readout shows this is sharp.
对每个输入都守恒指针权重，意味着每个 Kraus 算符都与 P 对易，所以随机混合藏不住泄漏。近守恒时，在平方根量级的距离内有一个精确守恒的等距；一个旋转读口说明这是锐的。

Stability needs two budgets: summable mean drift, and an information error merely tending to zero; then the posterior polarises. With sine theta n equal one over n plus two, errors are unsummable but squares sum, so the pointer settles.
稳定需要两份预算：可求和的平均漂移，以及只需趋于零的信息误差。这样后验就会极化。取 sinθₙ = 1/(n + 2)，误差不可求和而平方可求和，所以指针稳定下来。

To predict the next outcome within epsilon after every history, a deterministic predictor needs exactly N epsilon plus two states, logarithmic in one over epsilon and independent of the time span; for zero error, no finite predictor exists.
要在每一段历史之后把下一结果预测到 ε 以内，确定性预测器恰需 N_ε + 2 个状态，对 1/ε 呈对数增长，且与时间跨度无关；若要零误差，则不存在有限状态的预测器。
Other resources differ: depth n coherent records compress to a qubit, while an archive of all histories needs two to the n dimensions and cannot be reset for free. A clock only moves the counter.
其他资源各不相同：深度 n 的相干记录可压缩到一个 qubit；而保存全部历史的档案需要 2ⁿ 维，且不能免费重置。时钟只是把计数器挪了位置。
Now give the protected sector a tiny dark outcome with probability s. The readout still conserves P exactly, and over n rounds the record laws differ by at most q zero n s.
现在给受保护扇区一个概率为 s 的微小暗结果。读口仍精确守恒 P，n 轮之内记录律至多相差 q₀ns。

Yet a finite predictor for all histories now exists only when epsilon is at least x minus s, over two: rare reverse evidence always swings the posterior back. Almost-sure selection does not buy finite memory.
然而此时，覆盖全部历史的有限预测器只在 ε ≥ (x − s)/2 时存在：稀有的反向证据总能把后验拉回。几乎必然的选支换不来有限记忆。

Calibrations fix the ruler, positivity needs commuting records, information adds orthogonally, golden gates form a fractal, a one-sided readout needs N plus two states, and a dark outcome breaks that bound.
校准确定尺子，正性需要对易的记录，信息正交地累加，黄金门构成分形，单侧读口需要 N + 2 个状态，而一个暗结果打破这个界。

The native port, one-sided history law and memory theorem are frozen in Lean; Fisher geometry is published, source contracts come from the quantum continuation, the rest is argued in the volumes, and the finite computations were redone for this film.
原生读口、单侧历史律与记忆定理已在 Lean 中冻结；Fisher 几何是已发表的结果，源合同来自量子续卷，其余结论在理论卷中论证，有限计算都为本片重新做过。
